description: PAID $0.004 USDC. Before paying or trading: send one wallet or token and get safe / caution / block, a 0-100 safety score and reasons. Auto-detects token vs wallet; combines token contract checks (impostor symbol, owner, proxy, Solana mint/freeze authority), holder concentration, wallet profile, whale history and spam filters. Chains ethereum, base, solana. No charge on failure. Returns JSON safe, caution, or block, a 0-100 safety score, and the reasons.

address.description: Wallet, token contract, or Solana mint. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint. Example: 0x28C6c06298d514Db089934071355E5743bf21d60. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the wallet or token. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: ethereum. Allowed values: ethereum, base, solana.
